scientific_integrity: Exact analytical symmetry decomposition and sign proof, supplemented with symbolic identities and independent direct rational inverses. The literature overlap comparison is bounded and historical originality not certified.
scientific_limitations: Two noise-free leaders, unit intra-clique edges, single positive weighted bridge, and a K2 satellite; no extension to arbitrary two-clique orders, distinct noise covariance, multiple bridges or alternative control objectives. Independent review not performed.
title: Sharp two-leader coupling threshold for a weighted clique barbell
